premise: Bee finds something sweet and wiggles a funny dance; Caterpillar and Ladybug think it's just a dance and join in, until they follow where the dance points and find Flower.
inspiration: A Just So question ("why does the bee dance?", Kipling), answered truly instead of tall.
lesson: Listen to what a friend is really trying to tell you.
learning: Bees do a little dance to show other bees where the flowers are.

en-US.title: Bee Dances the Way
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:enter} Bee came {sfx:buzz} buzzing home, fizzing with news. {bee:face happy} She had found something SWEET, and she wanted to tell her friends. [excited] So she did what bees do: {bee:live hum} she hummed her tune and danced a wiggly dance. {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to bee} Caterpillar crawled up to watch. {caterpillar:face happy} [giggles] "What a funny dance!" {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to bee} Ladybug came too. "Can we dance?" So they all wiggled. {caterpillar:live wiggle} Wiggle, waggle, wiggle! {ladybug:live wings} Ladybug even {sfx:flutter} fluttered her wings and took a bow. {bee:face sad} [sighs] "No, no," said Bee. "It's not just a dance. It's a bee map! It shows the way to the flowers." {bee:live waggle-dance} She danced it again, wiggling one way. {caterpillar:live look-up} Caterpillar reared up tall to look. [curious] "That way?" {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} "That way!" And there, just where the dance said, was a yellow {flower:enter} flower. {bee:go to flower} {caterpillar:go to flower} {ladybug:go to flower by fly} Off they went: buzz, crawl, flutter! {flower:face happy} [happily] "Hello!" said Flower. {caterpillar:face surprised} "Your dance was right!" said Caterpillar. {all:hop} So they danced again, {flower:wobble} Flower too. Wiggle, waggle… SWEET!

es-ES.title: El baile de Abeja
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:enter} Abeja volvió {sfx:buzz} zumbando, loca de contenta. {bee:face happy} ¡Había encontrado algo DULCE, y quería contárselo a sus amigas! [excited] Así que hizo lo que hacen las abejas: {bee:live hum} tarareó su canción y se puso a bailar, meneándose. {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to bee} Oruga se acercó a mirar. {caterpillar:face happy} [giggles] —¡Qué baile tan gracioso! Y llegó {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to bee} Mariquita: —¿Podemos bailar? Y se menearon todas. {caterpillar:live wiggle} ¡Meneo por aquí, meneo por allá! {ladybug:live wings} Mariquita hasta {sfx:flutter} batió las alas e hizo una reverencia. {bee:face sad} [sighs] —Que no, que no —dijo Abeja—. ¡No es un baile, es un mapa de abeja! Dice por dónde se va a las flores. {bee:live waggle-dance} Lo bailó otra vez, hacia un lado. {caterpillar:live look-up} Oruga se estiró bien alta para mirar. [curious] —¿Por allí? {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} —¡Por allí! Y allí, justo donde decía el baile, había una {flower:enter} flor amarilla. {bee:go to flower} {caterpillar:go to flower} {ladybug:go to flower by fly} Y allá fueron: zumbando, reptando, volando. {flower:face happy} [happily] —¡Hola! —dijo Flor. {caterpillar:face surprised} —¡Tu baile tenía razón! —dijo Oruga. {all:hop} Y volvieron a bailar, {flower:wobble} Flor también. Meneo por aquí, meneo por allá… ¡y qué DULCE!

ja-JP.title: ミツバチさんの ちずダンス
ja-JP.text: {bee:float loop 0.4}{bee:enter}ミツバチさんが、{sfx:buzz}ぶんぶん、うきうき、かえってきました。{bee:face happy}あまーいものを見つけたから、なかまにおしえたいの。[excited]そこで、ミツバチらしく、{bee:live hum}はなうたをうたって、ふりふりダンス！{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to bee}あおむしさんが、もぞもぞ見にきました。{caterpillar:face happy}[giggles]「おもしろいダンス！」 {ladybug:enter}{ladybug:go to bee}テントウムシさんも、「おどっていい？」 みんなで、ふりふり。{caterpillar:live wiggle}くねくね、ふりふり！{ladybug:live wings}テントウムシさんは、{sfx:flutter}はねをぱたぱた、ぺこりとおじぎまで。{bee:face sad}[sighs]「ちがうの、ちがうの」 とミツバチさん。「これは、ミツバチのちずなの！花のあるところを、おしえてるのよ。」 {bee:live waggle-dance}もういちど、あっちのほうへ、ふりふり。{caterpillar:live look-up}あおむしさんが、ぐーんとのびあがって、[curious]「あっち？」 {bee:face happy}{bee:hop}「あっち！」 ほんとうに、ダンスのとおりのところに、きいろい{flower:enter}お花！{bee:go to flower}{caterpillar:go to flower}{ladybug:go to flower by fly}ぶーん、もぞもぞ、ぱたぱた！{flower:face happy}[happily]「こんにちは！」 とお花。{caterpillar:face surprised}「ダンス、あたってた！」 とあおむしさん。{all:hop}みんなでまたおどりました。{flower:wobble}お花も、いっしょに。ふりふり、くねくね…あまーい！

de-DE.title: Die Biene tanzt den Weg
de-DE.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:enter} Die Biene {sfx:buzz} summte nach Hause und platzte fast vor Neuigkeiten. {bee:face happy} Sie hatte etwas SÜSSES gefunden und wollte es allen erzählen. [excited] Also tat sie, was Bienen tun: {bee:live hum} Sie summte und tanzte einen Wackeltanz. {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to bee} Die Raupe kroch neugierig herbei. {caterpillar:face happy} [giggles] „Was für ein lustiger Tanz!“ {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to bee} Der Marienkäfer kam auch. „Dürfen wir mittanzen?“ Also wackelten alle. {caterpillar:live wiggle} Wackel hier, wackel da! {ladybug:live wings} Der Marienkäfer {sfx:flutter} flatterte sogar und verbeugte sich. {bee:face sad} [sighs] „Nein, nein“, sagte die Biene. „Das ist nicht bloß ein Tanz, das ist eine Landkarte für Bienen! Sie zeigt den Weg zu den Blumen.“ {bee:live waggle-dance} Sie tanzte noch einmal und wackelte in eine Richtung. {caterpillar:live look-up} Die Raupe reckte sich ganz hoch. [curious] „Da lang?“ {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} „Da lang!“ Und genau dort, wohin der Tanz gezeigt hatte, stand eine gelbe {flower:enter} Blume. {bee:go to flower} {caterpillar:go to flower} {ladybug:go to flower by fly} Los ging’s: summ, kriech, flatter! {flower:face happy} [happily] „Hallo!“, sagte die Blume. {caterpillar:face surprised} „Dein Tanz hat gestimmt!“, sagte die Raupe. {all:hop} Und sie tanzten noch mal, {flower:wobble} die Blume auch. Wackel hier, wackel da… mmh, SÜSS!

fr-FR.title: La danse d’Abeille
fr-FR.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:enter} Abeille est rentrée {sfx:buzz} en bourdonnant. {bee:face happy} Elle avait trouvé quelque chose de SUCRÉ, et elle voulait le dire à ses amies. [excited] Alors elle a fait comme les abeilles : {bee:live hum} elle a fredonné et dansé en se tortillant. {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to bee} Chenille s’est approchée pour regarder. {caterpillar:face happy} [giggles] « Quelle drôle de danse ! » {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to bee} Coccinelle est venue aussi : « On peut danser ? » Et toutes se sont tortillées. {caterpillar:live wiggle} Tortille, frétille, tortille ! {ladybug:live wings} Coccinelle a même {sfx:flutter} battu des ailes et fait la révérence. {bee:face sad} [sighs] « Non, non, a dit Abeille. Ce n’est pas qu’une danse, c’est une carte d’abeille ! Elle montre le chemin des fleurs. » {bee:live waggle-dance} Elle a redansé en se tortillant, toujours du même côté. {caterpillar:live look-up} Chenille s’est dressée pour voir. [curious] « Par là ? » {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} « Par là ! » Et là, comme l’avait dit la danse : une {flower:enter} fleur jaune ! {bee:go to flower} {caterpillar:go to flower} {ladybug:go to flower by fly} Et hop : bzzz, rampe, volette ! {flower:face happy} [happily] « Bonjour ! » a dit Fleur. {caterpillar:face surprised} « Ta danse avait raison ! » a dit Chenille. {all:hop} Et elles ont redansé, {flower:wobble} Fleur aussi. Tortille, frétille… et MIAM !

it-IT.title: Il ballo di Ape
it-IT.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:enter} Ape è tornata a casa {sfx:buzz} ronzando, piena di novità. {bee:face happy} Aveva trovato qualcosa di DOLCE, e voleva dirlo agli amici. [excited] Così ha fatto quello che fanno le api: {bee:live hum} ha canticchiato la sua canzone e si è messa a ballare, dondolando. {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to bee} Bruco si è avvicinato a guardare. {caterpillar:face happy} [giggles] «Che ballo buffo!» E poi è arrivata {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to bee} Coccinella: «Possiamo ballare anche noi?» E tutti a dondolare! {caterpillar:live wiggle} Dondola di qua, dondola di là! {ladybug:live wings} Coccinella ha perfino {sfx:flutter} sbattuto le ali e ha fatto un inchino. {bee:face sad} [sighs] «No, no», ha detto Ape. «Non è solo un ballo. È una mappa da api! Indica la strada per i fiori.» {bee:live waggle-dance} Ha ripetuto il ballo, dondolando tutta da una parte. {caterpillar:live look-up} Bruco si è alzato bello dritto per guardare. [curious] «Di là?» {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} «Di là!» E proprio lì, dove diceva il ballo, c'era un {flower:enter} fiore giallo. {bee:go to flower} {caterpillar:go to flower} {ladybug:go to flower by fly} Via tutti: chi ronzando, chi strisciando, chi volando! {flower:face happy} [happily] «Ciao!» ha detto Fiore. {caterpillar:face surprised} «Il tuo ballo aveva ragione!» ha detto Bruco. {all:hop} Così hanno ballato di nuovo, {flower:wobble} anche Fiore. Dondola di qua, dondola di là… che DOLCE!

zh-TW.title: 蜜蜂跳舞指路
zh-TW.text: {bee:float loop 0.4}{bee:enter}蜜蜂{sfx:buzz}嗡嗡嗡地飛回家，有個大消息快要藏不住了。{bee:face happy}牠找到了甜滋滋的東西，好想告訴朋友們！[excited]所以，牠做了蜜蜂都會做的事：{bee:live hum}哼著歌，跳起扭來扭去的舞。{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to bee}毛毛蟲爬過來看。{caterpillar:face happy}[giggles]「這支舞好好笑喔！」 {ladybug:enter}{ladybug:go to bee}瓢蟲也來了。「我們也可以跳嗎？」 於是，大家一起扭。{caterpillar:live wiggle}扭一扭，搖一搖，扭一扭！{ladybug:live wings}瓢蟲還{sfx:flutter}拍拍翅膀，鞠了一個躬。{bee:face sad}[sighs]「不是啦，不是啦。」 蜜蜂說，「這不只是跳舞，這是蜜蜂的地圖！它告訴大家，花在哪裡。」 {bee:live waggle-dance}牠又跳了一次，朝著一個方向扭過去。{caterpillar:live look-up}毛毛蟲把身體抬得高高的，往那邊看。[curious]「是那邊嗎？」 {bee:face happy}{bee:hop}「就是那邊！」 就在舞蹈說的地方，有一朵黃色的{flower:enter}小花。{bee:go to flower}{caterpillar:go to flower}{ladybug:go to flower by fly}大家出發囉：嗡嗡飛、慢慢爬、拍拍翅膀！{flower:face happy}[happily]「哈囉！」 小花說。{caterpillar:face surprised}「你的舞說對了耶！」 毛毛蟲說。{all:hop}於是大家又跳了一次，{flower:wobble}小花也一起跳。扭一扭，搖一搖……甜滋滋！

zh-HK.title: 蜜蜂跳舞帶路
zh-HK.text: {bee:float loop 0.4}{bee:enter}蜜蜂{sfx:buzz}嗡嗡嗡地飛回來，有個好消息急着要說。{bee:face happy}牠找到了一些甜甜的東西，好想告訴朋友們！[excited]於是，牠做了蜜蜂都會做的事：{bee:live hum}一邊哼歌，一邊扭來扭去地跳舞。{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to bee}毛毛蟲爬過來看。{caterpillar:face happy}[giggles]「呢隻舞好得意呀！」 {ladybug:enter}{ladybug:go to bee}瓢蟲也來了。「我哋可唔可以一齊跳？」 於是大家一起扭。{caterpillar:live wiggle}扭呀扭，擺呀擺，扭呀扭！{ladybug:live wings}瓢蟲還{sfx:flutter}拍拍翅膀，鞠了一個躬。{bee:face sad}[sighs]「唔係呀，唔係呀。」 蜜蜂說，「呢個唔只係跳舞，係蜜蜂地圖嚟㗎！佢話你知花喺邊度。」 {bee:live waggle-dance}牠又跳了一次，向着一邊扭過去。{caterpillar:live look-up}毛毛蟲把身子挺得高高的，向那邊望。[curious]「係嗰邊？」 {bee:face happy}{bee:hop}「就係嗰邊！」 就在舞蹈指着的地方，有一朵黃色的{flower:enter}小花。{bee:go to flower}{caterpillar:go to flower}{ladybug:go to flower by fly}大家出發了：嗡嗡飛、慢慢爬、拍拍翅膀！{flower:face happy}[happily]「哈囉！」 小花說。{caterpillar:face surprised}「你隻舞真係冇講錯！」 毛毛蟲說。{all:hop}於是大家又跳起舞來，{flower:wobble}小花也一起跳。扭呀扭，擺呀擺……甜蜜蜜！

buzz.prompt: a bee buzzing close by, happy and busy, realistic

flutter.prompt: tiny insect wings fluttering, very light and quick, close
